environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8 application deployed on an AWS ECS Fargate task behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) with a standard HTTPS listener (TLS termination at ALB, no client certificate requirement). The ALB forwards all requests with valid TLS to the target group. The ECS task has an IAM task role with ec2:DescribeInstances and ssm:GetParameter permissions. The VPC has no egress restrictions; the task can reach the EC2 metadata service at 169.254.169.254 via IMDSv1 (no hop limit enforcement). DNS resolution is handled by the default VPC resolver with no filtering.

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443 with ACM certificate, no mutual TLS
